I am Yuting Xia, a graduate student in Applied Economics and Data Science at the University of Pennsylvania. My experience includes securities research at Huatai, data analytics at Tencent, and AI product development at SDIC Cloud Network Technology. I work with Python, Stata, Java, SQL/MySQL, R, and Excel, and am interested in applying economics and data analysis to financial research.
